content: Uḍuf n Yasuɛ
Awarni řami inna Yasuɛ aya, iffeɣ ak-d imeḥḍaren nnes, ẓwan x yeɣzar n Qidrun. Tuɣa din ijj n weḥwic, yudef ɣares ak-d imeḥḍaren nnes.
Maca uřa d Yahuda, aɣeddar, issen amcan nni ɛawed, minzi Yasuɛ tuɣa issmuna dayes aṭṭas ak-d imeḥḍaren nnes.
Yiwi-dd Yahuda akides ict n terbiɛt n řɛeskar uřa d iɛessasen zeg wudem n imeqqranen n ikehhanen d Ifarisiyyen, uca yusa-dd diha s iṣefḍawen d řeqnadeř d řesnaḥ.
Yasuɛ, wenni issen marra min d as ɣa imsaren, iffeɣ-dd ɣarsen, inna asen: “Min xef tarezzum?”
Arrin-dd xas: “Yasuɛ Nnaṣiri!” Yasuɛ inna asen: “D NECC!” Tuɣa Yahuda, aɣeddar, ibedd ɛawed akidsen.
Řami d asen inna Yasuɛ: “D Necc!”, dewřen nitni ɣar ḍeffar uca wḍan ɣar temmurt.
Isseqsa ten Yasuɛ ɛawed: “Min xef tarezzum?” Nnan: “Yasuɛ Nnaṣiri!”
Yasuɛ yarra-dd: “Aqa nniɣ awem, aqa d Necc. Mařa tarezzum xafi, jjem ina ad raḥen!”,
ḥima ad ittwakemmeř wawař i tuɣa inna: “Inni d ayi tewcid, war zzaysen weddareɣ uřa d ijj.”
Cimɛun Buṭrus wenni tuɣa ɣares ssif, ijbed i-t-i-dd, iwta zzayes amsexxar n arrays n ikehhanen, iqess as amezzuɣ nnes afusi. Tuɣa amsexxar nni qqaren as Malxis.
Xas uca inna Yasuɛ i Buṭrus: “Arr ssif ɣar weɣřaf nnes, řkas nni d ayi iwca Baba, ma war t sesseɣ?”
Yasuɛ zzat i Ḥannan, azeǧif n ikehhanen
Tarbiɛt n řɛeskar d imeqqranen x wařef n iɛeskariyyen uřa d iɛessasen n Wudayen ṭṭfen Yasuɛ, carfen t.
Nedhen t amezwaru ɣar Ḥannan, minzi netta d aḍeggʷař n Qayafa, wenni tuɣa d arrays n ikehhanen deg useggʷas nni.
Qayafa d netta tuɣa iweṣṣa i Wudayen, aqa ḥsen ad immet ijj n Bnadem di ṭṭweɛ n řgens.
Ankar n Buṭrus
Cimɛun Buṭrus iḍfar Yasuɛ ak-d ijjen zeg imeḥḍaren inneɣni. Ameḥḍar nni tuɣa ittwassnen ɣar arrays n ikehhanen uca yudef ak-d Yasuɛ ɣar řemraḥ n taddart n arrays n ikehhanen.
Cimɛun ibedd-dd barra ɣar tewwart. Iffeɣ-dd umeḥḍar i tuɣa ittwassnen ɣar arrays n ikehhanen, issiweř ak-d tɛessast tenni iḥeṭṭan tawwart uca issidef-dd Cimɛun ɣar daxeř.
Tabřiɣt tenni iḥeṭṭan tawwart, tenna i Cimɛun: “Ma war teǧid uřa d cek zeg imeḥḍaren n bnadem-a?” Inna: “Lla!”
Tuɣa imsexxaren d iɛessasen bedden din, ssarɣen timessi s řefḥem, minzi tuɣa tesmeḍ, uca tuɣa ttweqqaḥen. Uřa d Cimɛun ibedd akidsen, ittweqqaḥ.
Iseqsiten n arrays n ikehhanen i Yasuɛ
Isseqsa arrays n ikehhanen Yasuɛ x imeḥḍaren nnes u x tɣuri nnes.
Yarra-dd xas Yasuɛ: “Necc tuɣa ssawařeɣ i řgens s bṭayṭay, ssɣareɣ řebda di temzida u di Zzawect Tameqqrant mani ttmunan Wudayen řebda. Di tnuffra war ssiwřeɣ uřa d ict n řḥajjet.
Mayemmi d ayi tesseqsid? Seqsa inni isřan min d asen nniɣ. Xzar, nitni ssnen min nniɣ!”
Řami inna ammu, xenni ijjen zeg iɛessasen i tuɣa din ibedden, iwta Yasuɛ x umeggiz nnes, inna as: “Ma ammu i dd ɣa tarred x arrays n ikehhanen?”
Yarra-dd xas Yasuɛ, inna: “Mařa ssiwřeɣ min war iḥřin, ched x min war iḥřin, maca mařa ssiwřeɣ mliḥ, mayemmi d ayi teccated xenni?”
Xas uca Ḥannan issekk i-t ittwacarf ɣar Qayafa, arrays n ikehhanen.
Cimɛun Buṭrus inkar ɛawed aqa netta issen Yasuɛ
Tuɣa Cimɛun Buṭrus ibedd dinni ittweqqaḥ. Nnan as: “Ma war teǧid uřa d cek zeg imeḥḍaren nnes?” Netta inkar, inna: “War ǧiɣ ca d necc!”
Ijjen zeg imsexxaren n arrays n ikehhanen i tuɣa itteɛnan i wenni umi iqess Cimɛun amezzuɣ, inna: “Ma war cek ẓriɣ akides deg weḥwic?”
Řexdenni inkar Cimɛun ɛawed uca deɣya issquqeɛ uyaẓiḍ.
Yasuɛ zzat i Pilaṭus
Xenni iwyen-dd Yasuɛ zi Qayafa ɣar taddart n ccreɛ, umi qqaren ‘Prituriyum’. Tuɣa d zic di ṣṣbeḥ. Nitni war udifen ca ɣar taddart n ccreɛ, ḥima war ttwessixen qbeř ma i ɣa ccen Tɣarṣt n Useɛdu.
S uyenni iffeɣ-dd ɣarsen Pilaṭus, inna asen: “Man acetci i ɣarwem x Weryaz-a?”
Arrin-dd, nnan as: “Mařa Wanita war tuɣi d mmis n řmuɛṣiyyet, ad tiři war d ac t-i-dd-nettiwi.”
Inna asen Pilaṭus: “Xenni awyem t-i-dd kenniw, tḥekmem xas ɛlaḥsab Ccariɛa nwem.” Xenni nnan as Wudayen: “War ɣarneɣ bu ttesriḥ maḥend ad neneɣ uřa d ijj!”,
ḥima ad ittwakemmeř wawař n Yasuɛ i tuɣa iqqar, am tuɣa isscanen i man řmewt i ɣa immet.
Xenni yudef-dd Pilaṭus ɛawed ɣar taddart n Ccraɛ, umi qqaren Prituriyum, iřaɣa-dd x Yasuɛ, inna as: “Ma Cek d Ajeǧid n Wudayen?”
Yarra-dd xas Yasuɛ: “Ma teqqared aya zi ɣarek niɣ tuɣa inneɣni qqaren ac t xafi?”
Inna as Pilaṭus: “Ma necc d Uday? Aqa řgens nnec d imeqqranen n ikehhanen iwyen-dd Cek ɣari. Min tuɣa teggid?”

Yarra-dd xas Yasuɛ: “Tageldit inu war teǧi ca zi ddunect-a. Mařa teǧa Tgeldit inu zi ddunect-a, ad yiři aqa imsexxaren inu ad mmenɣen, ḥima war ttwasellameɣ i Wudayen, maca řexxu Tageldit inu war teǧi ca ssanita.”

Inna as Pilaṭus: “Xenni aqa Cek d Ajeǧid nican!” Yarra-dd Yasuɛ: “Cek teqqared, aqa Necc d Ajeǧid. I man aya i dd-xeřqeɣ u i uya i dd-usiɣ ɣar ddunect, ḥima ad cehdeɣ i tidett. Marra wenni iǧan zi tidett, ad iseř i tmijja inu.”
Inna as Pilaṭus: “Umi qqaren d tidett?” Řami inna ammu, iffeɣ-dd ɛawed ɣar Wudayen, inna asen: “War dayes ufiɣ uřa d ijj n uxeṭṭu.
Maca aqa tennumem ad awem sarrḥeɣ ijj n bnadem di Řɛid n Tɣarṣt n Useɛdu. Ma texsem xenni ad awem sarrḥeɣ Bnadem-a, Ajeǧid n Wudayen?”
Sɣuyyen ɛawed marra, nnan: “War iǧi ca Wanita, ḥaca Bar-Abbas!” Tuɣa Bar-Abbas d aqṭaṭɛiy.
